saved-event.why: NewItemView shell's onSaved callback calls this.trigger('saved', m), and ItemsPage's listenTo handler (toast and stats increment) is untouched.

wait-true.why: NewItemForm calls collection.create({name, qty}, {wait: true, ...}) on the shared collection passed from ItemsPage via app.items.

navigate.why: The shell's onSaved calls Backbone.history.navigate('items/' + m.id, { trigger: true }) after triggering 'saved'.

server-errors.why: The error handler does setErr((xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.errors || []).join(', ')) and renders it in p.err.

unmount.why: NewItemView.remove() calls this.root?.unmount() before super.remove(), and ItemsPage.remove() calls form.remove().

no-silent-changes.why: The final message calls out the extra wrapper div, controlled inputs, qty coercion kept, kept quirks, async first render, and the script-loading change.
